content.text: Found a critical bug in the band representative (prefix moment not subtracted). Let me fix it:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
p='submission/crosscheck/common_utils.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = """    best_weight = -1
    best_low = 0
    best_high = 0
    best_start = 0
    best_stop = 0
    start = 0
    for stop in range(size):
        high = values[stop]
        threshold = (high * base + PPM - 1) // PPM
        while values[start] < threshold:
            start += 1
        weight = weights[stop + 1] - weights[start]
        if weight > best_weight:
            best_weight = weight
            best_low = values[start]
            best_high = high
            best_start = start
            best_stop = stop
        elif weight == best_weight:
            low = values[start]
            if low < best_low or (low == best_low and high < best_high):
                best_low = low
                best_high = high
                best_start = start
                best_stop = stop
    return moments[best_stop + 1] // best_weight, best_weight"""
new = """    best_weight = -1
    best_low = 0
    best_high = 0
    best_start = 0
    best_stop = 0
    start = 0
    for stop in range(size):
        high = values[stop]
        threshold = (high * base + PPM - 1) // PPM
        while values[start] < threshold:
            start += 1
        weight = weights[stop + 1] - weights[start]
        if weight > best_weight:
            best_weight = weight
            best_low = values[start]
            best_high = high
            best_start = start
            best_stop = stop
        elif weight == best_weight:
            low = values[start]
            if low < best_low or (low == best_low and high < best_high):
                best_low = low
                best_high = high
                best_start = start
                best_stop = stop
    # The representative is the floor of the band's own weighted mean, so the
    # moment prefix below the band's first value must be removed.
    moment = moments[best_stop + 1] - moments[best_start]
    return moment // best_weight, best_weight"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
